outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the differentiation protocol, not a plot of data.
Panel B shows western blots, which is a blot, not a plot requiring individual data points.

Panel C consists of line plots of marker gene expression over a time-course (mean ± SEM). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel D shows live fluorescence micrographs of EBs, not a plot.
Panel E shows flow cytometry scatter/density plots where each point represents an individual cell, so individual data points are inherently displayed.
Panel F is a line plot of positive cell proportions (mean ± SEM) across conditions; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel G is a line plot of positive cell proportions (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows immunostaining micrographs of whole-mount EBs, not a plot.
Panel I uses standard Tukey boxplots to show RNA-seq read counts across sorted populations; box plots already convey the data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel J consists of hierarchical clustering heatmaps of gene expression; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
